title: The Quiet Orbit Anew
author: Jonah Nystrom
blurb: Quentin Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
